serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Before we go to the place of our date, I need to pick some things I ordered from the internet.
Bot: Smart lockers are truly a marvelous invention. 
Bot: Did you know that using them lowers carbon emissions? 
You: No, I did not. 
It’s hard for me to focus on a conversation when I’m worrying about what kind of surprise she prepared for me…
Bot: It’s here! My items I ordered! What do you think?
You: For what do we need… {{wi}}basket, blanket and snacks?
Bot: We are going to have a picnic!
You: Picnic? It’s {gv_Hour}...{{wi}} Couldn’t we go during the day? I also don’t think there is any place with grass nearby to sit on.
Bot: Don’t worry, it’s not your ordinary picnic! It’s a stargazing picnic!
Bot: I checked the weather before and downloaded some star maps so I could tell you about stars and constellations.
You: I never went stargazing before. It might be fun. I think I remember people doing it back in my home city.
Bot: So it will be your first time! That’s great!
Bot: Now that we have everything we need, we can go on top of one of the skyscrapers.
